top_signals.title: Ex-Taula Trader Matteo Sardo to Join Millennium
top_signals.summary: Portfolio Manager Matteo Sardo, who specializes in rates trading reneged on an offer he accepted to go to Cohen’s Point72 Asset Management, according to people with knowledge of the matter. He is returning to his former employer Millennium Management, which is run by Izzy Englander, the people said, asking not to be identified discussing private information. Hema Parmar has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Consumer Sentiment Falls on Worries About Prices, Economy
top_signals.summary: US consumer sentiment fell in September to a four-month low amid deepening worries about rising prices and the outlook for the economy.
